prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the best choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need full-service help (SEO + paid media + content + web) or a specialist (PPC, SEO, social, web design). I can recommend specific agencies if you tell me those details, but here are quick, practical steps to find the right one and some things to look for.

Questions I need to recommend agencies:
- What’s your primary goal? (lead gen, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, product launch, recruitment)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget range
- Industry (B2B, healthcare, law, retail, SaaS, etc.)
- Do you need local St. Louis presence or is remote OK?
- Do you need strategy + execution or just tactical help?

How to evaluate agencies (checklist)
- Relevant experience: case studies in your industry and similar budgets
- Measurable results: examples of KPIs achieved (lead volume, CAC, ROAS, organic traffic growth)
- Process and reporting: regular reports, dashboards, clear deliverables
- Team and roles: who will actually do the work (not just an AE)
- Tools & certifications: Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, Shopify, Analytics, etc.
- Contract terms: notice period, scope changes, IP ownership
- Cultural fit and communication style

Where to search and compare
- Clutch.co, UpCity, DesignRush (reviews and ranked lists)
- Google Maps and Google Reviews for local reputation
- LinkedIn company pages and employee profiles
- Local lists: St. Louis Business Journal, “Best of St. Louis” awards
- Referrals from peers in your industry

Questions to ask agencies in interviews
- What results have you achieved for companies like ours? Can you share metrics?
- What will you do in the first 30/60/90 days?
- Who will be our day‑to‑day contact and what’s the escalation path?
- How do you measure ROI and which KPIs will you report?
- Which tools do you use and what additional costs should we expect?
- Can you share a sample report and a recent case study?

Red flags
- Vague promises like “we’ll get you to #1”
- No clear metrics, case studies, or references
- High-pressure promises with locked long-term contracts and no exit clauses
- Lack of transparency on ad spend or agency fees

If you want, I can:
- Curate a short list of top-rated St. Louis agencies tailored to your answers above
- Draft an RFP or an outreach email to send to shortlisted agencies
Tell me your goals and budget and I’ll prepare a targeted shortlist and next steps.
